meta.note: Scene lists are hand-curated (INFERRED) and ordered best-first; ids are validated against bl_scenes.json and the install. Supersedes mapping.json terrain_scenes/climate_*/season_*/time_of_day.

reorder: winter season -> stable-move scenes with snow_layer to the front (46 field scenes have a winter-only snow layer)
relief class high (relief7Raw >= p67 of the terrain) -> stable-move relief_high scenes forward; low (<= p33) -> relief_low forward
battle with >= large_battle_agents agents -> drop scenes whose smaller side is < large_battle_min_scene_m (keep at least one)

siege.scene_levels: level_<wall> siege (pass sceneUpgradeLevel 1..3; 0 means level_3 in the stock siege opener, BannerlordMissions)

village.use_when: tribal holding sieges; optional settlement-edge battles

season.no_winter_split: Dec -> fall, Jan-Feb -> spring (the campaign does the same for clear winter days: DefaultMapWeatherModel)

winter_from_modifier.mild: winter if bucket in mild_winter_buckets or winterBias >= 0.6, else no winter
